name: Remote Assistance
description:
*An ally gains the benefit of your intellect.*

**Maneuver** — Psionic, Ranged — Maneuver

**Distance:** Ranged 12   **Target:** One creature or object

**Effect:** The next ability roll an ally makes against the target before the start of your next turn gains an edge. Spend 1 Clarity: You target one additional creature or object.
